text_edits.replacement_html: code REQUIRED. authorization server가 생성한 authorization code입니다. 유출 위험을 줄이기 위해 authorization code는 발급 후 짧은 시간 안에 만료되어야 합니다(MUST). authorization code의 최대 유효 기간은 10분으로 하는 것이 권장됩니다(RECOMMENDED). client는 authorization code를 두 번 이상 사용해서는 안 됩니다(MUST NOT). authorization code가 두 번 이상 사용되면 authorization server는 해당 요청을 거부해야 하며(MUST), 가능하다면 그 authorization code를 기반으로 이전에 발급한 모든 token을 폐기하는 것이 좋습니다(SHOULD). authorization code는 client identifier 및 redirection URI에 바인딩됩니다.
text_edits.source_text: code REQUIRED. The authorization code generated by the authorization server. The authorization code MUST expire shortly after it is issued to mitigate the risk of leaks. A maximum authorization code lifetime of 10 minutes is RECOMMENDED. The client MUST NOT use the authorization code more than once. If an authorization code is used more than once, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code. The authorization code is bound to the client identifier and redirection URI.
text_edits.evidence: AI source comparison of RFC 6749 4.1.2: keeps the single-use prohibition, client/server roles, ten-minute RECOMMENDED maximum, MUST expiry/denial, conditional SHOULD revocation and client/URI binding. Only the malformed placement of MUST NOT is repaired; English nouns and all other facts remain.
